subject: Mutual Action Plan: closing playbook + stakeholder roles (FinWave)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@finwave.com>; Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@finwave.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap and MAP v1 (next steps)

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the demo today. Great conversation and very helpful signal on priorities. Per our call I’m attaching a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that lays out milestones, proposed owners, and dependencies so we have a single place to align on timing and decision points. Highlights in this first pass: 

- Target commercial close: 2027-04-15 (provisional)
- Key milestones: 1) Security review (SOC2 questionnaire complete) by 2027-03-18, 2) Tech POC & perf test by 2027-03-31, 3) Contract & SOW sign by 2027-04-10
- Proposed RACI (economic buyer / procurement / security / legal / eng lead) included on sheet 2 of the attachment

Request from our side: can you confirm the names for the security owner and legal reviewer so we can lock the timeline? Also flag any mandatory procurement steps (PO, vendor setup) we should account for as dependencies.

Attachments: FinWave_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2-Responses_FinWave.pdf (requested fields)

Next step: I’ll follow up mid-week to capture stakeholder names and adjust the MAP. If it’s helpful I can propose a short stakeholder RACI call (15–20m) to confirm ownership live.

Cheers,
Laura

Subject: Re: Quick recap and MAP v1 (next steps)

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the recap and for pulling the MAP together so quickly. I reviewed the spreadsheet with Samir this morning. A few quick notes: 

- Security owner: that will be myself (I’ll own the SOC2 review and vendor security checklist).
- Legal reviewer: CC’d our in-house counsel (procure@finwave.com handles vendor paperwork routing — legal reviewer is likely Mia Chen from Legal, I’ll confirm by EOD).
- Economic owner: CFO (Victor Alvarez) — I’ll introduce him on the next email that includes the procurement timeline.

Question: we have an internal data residency check that could add a week (dependency). Can your team confirm whether private deployment (VPC) options and estimated lead times are documented in the MAP? If not, can we add that as a dependency under Security/Infra?

We’ll aim to confirm names by Thursday. For now, accept the MAP timeline with the caveat of the data residency dependency.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Engineering Operations — FinWave
elena.ortiz@finwave.com

Date: 2027-03-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap and MAP v1 (next steps)

Elena —

Appreciate the quick review and the ownership callout. We’ll add data residency as a formal dependency on the MAP and flag private deployment lead times. Marcus is looping in Neha from Solutions (security+deploy) to outline options and typical procurement/engineering lead times.

Updated asks from us to finalize MAP: 
- Confirm legal reviewer name (Mia Chen?) and procurement contact who will manage PO/vendor onboarding.
- Introduce Victor Alvarez (CFO) to the thread or confirm preferred evaluation cadence for commercial review.
- Any blackout windows for perf testing (dates we should avoid for your SRE/ops teams).

I’ve attached a slightly annotated MAP (v1.1) with the RACI filled with our suggested internal owners for coordination — see sheet 2. If you prefer, we can run a 20m RACI alignment call tomorrow.

Proposed short-term milestone updates: 
- Security questionnaire complete (owner: Elena) — target 2027-03-18
- Redwood POC + perf tests (owner: Marcus Lin) — target 2027-03-31; needs a 2-week window of cluster access (dependency: infra whitelisting)
- Final commercial review & SOW sign (owner: Victor Alvarez / Elena) — target 2027-04-10
- Go-live / scheduled rollout (owner: FinWave Eng + Redwood CS) — provisional 2027-05-01

Attachments: FinWave_MAP_DRAFT_v1.1.xlsx (annotated)

Thanks — I’ll wait for the legal/procurement names and we’ll lock the plan.

Laura

Subject: Re: Quick recap and MAP v1 (next steps)

Laura / Elena —

Thanks — quick clarification from our side: the procurement timeline for vendor setup is typically 10 business days after we submit vendor paperwork. That means if legal signoff slips, the commercial close could move by ~2 weeks. Also, we need to confirm whether Redwood’s standard SLAs and data retention policies are included in the SOW draft; procurement will not proceed until those are visible.

Security/infra note: Elena, please flag any network allowlist windows — we may need a maintenance window for perf tests.

I’ll have our procurement contact start vendor onboarding paperwork once Mia is looped in.

Samir

All —

Thanks for the clarifications. Per the thread I’ve updated the MAP and included the confirmed RACI mapping inline in the sheet: 

- Economic buyer: Victor Alvarez (CFO, FinWave) — expected commercial reviewer
- Security owner: Elena Ortiz (Head of Engineering Operations) — SOC2 and vendor security checklist owner
- Legal owner: Mia Chen (FinWave Legal) — contract review & redlines
- Engineering lead: Samir Gupta (Procurement/Eng ops) — perf test coordination and infra allowlist

Revised milestones & target close: 
- Security questionnaire complete: 2027-03-18 (owner: Elena)
- Vendor onboarding paperwork submitted: 2027-03-21 (owner: procure@finwave.com)
- Redwood POC + perf tests: 2027-04-01 to 2027-04-08 (owner: Marcus Lin) — dependency: infra allowlist and 2-week cluster access
- Commercial sign & SOW: 2027-04-15 (owner: Victor Alvarez / Mia Chen)

Dependencies: data residency confirmation (FinWave), procurement vendor setup (10 business days), legal turnaround for redlines (~5 business days), infra allowlist window (Elena to provide).

Next steps (action owners): 
- Elena to confirm data residency constraints and give a preferred maintenance window for perf tests (by 2027-03-05).
- Mia Chen (legal) to be introduced to this thread and sent SOW_Redwood_Template.docx for initial review (by 2027-03-07).
- Procurement to begin vendor paperwork submission once legal confirms (Samir / procure@finwave.com).
- Marcus and Neha will prep POC environment notes and a perf-test checklist; Marcus will propose test dates by 2027-03-08.

I’ve uploaded MAP v1.2 (final draft pending your legal/procurement signoffs) to the shared drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/0BzFinWave/map-drafts. I’ll also create a 20-minute RACI alignment call for Monday 2027-03-07 at 09:00 PT if that works for everyone — please reply with conflicts.

If this looks good I’ll also capture the items in our HubSpot opportunity (FW-2027-118) and link the SOW/DS documents for the procurement queue.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.
